As an ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT, GS-0303-7, you will: Maintains the appointment schedule for the HRO and the DHRO. Schedules appointments and meetings, independently, based upon personal knowledge of their workload and current issues of importance.

Advises the HRO and the DHRO of scheduled appointments and furnishes information from files or schedules briefings by others in preparation for scheduled meetings. Reschedules appointments when it is apparent that they cannot meet previous schedules. Attends meetings when required to maintain notes. Prepares required slides for meetings.

Receives visitors and telephone calls for the HRO. Assists in the development of policy letters. Coordinates draft policy with other staff directorates prior to submission for final review and approval.

Maintains personal contact with HRO employees, functional managers (Army and Air), NGB personnel, and State personnel to discuss administrative requirements and services. Provides technical advice and guidance and recommends methods and procedures where necessary.

Advises other administrative personnel of latest HRO directives regarding administrative procedures. Reviews incoming correspondence, publications, regulations, and directives.

Prepares and/or reviews outgoing correspondence from the office of the HRO or subordinate branches for grammar, construction, proper format, attachments, continuity of text, policy and procedural adherence, and compliance with the HRO viewpoint. Advises the originator of any discrepancies and provides necessary training.

Maintains office files of correspondence, directives, regulations, and other information. Maintains security of all keys and maintains appropriate records of keys issued to personnel. Performs duties as HRO Publications Officer.

Coordinates with both Army and Air Force publications sources to accomplish ordering, locating electronic publications, updating, and maintaining a current and complete publications library for the HRO. Submits work orders for repairs and maintenance on HRO office equipment and facilities. Performs other duties as assigned.
General Experience: Administrative or clerical experience, education, or training which demonstrates the candidate's ability to perform the duties of the position. Experience using computer and automation systems. Specialized Experience: Must have at least 12 months experience in the interpretation and application of regulations, procedures or laws.

Experience that provided a working knowledge of administrative functions. Experience demonstrating the ability to advise lower graded employees. Experience working independently and setting priorities with very little supervisory control.

Executive Assistant to Founder | AI Scale-Up | Remote (London) with travel
I’m working with an ambitious AI scale-up that is approaching an exciting stage of growth as they move towards Series A. They are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with the Founder and CEO, becoming a trusted extension of her and helping bring structure, organisation and efficiency to a fast-paced environment .
This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys working closely with a founder, managing competing priorities and playing a key role in helping scale a growing technology company.
This is not a traditional EA role focused purely on administration. You will play a key role in helping the Founder operate effectively day-to-day , managing communications, relationships and priorities across investors, customers, partners and the wider team.

Take ownership of the Founder’s busy inbox, prioritising communications, drafting responses and ensuring important conversations are followed up
Manage communications on behalf of the Founder with investors, prospective investors, angels, customers, startup programmes, partners and external stakeholders
Build trusted relationships and ensure all interactions reflect the professionalism of the business
Manage and organise a complex diary, ensuring the Founder’s time is prioritised effectively
Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, presentations and supporting materials ahead of important conversations
Support investor meetings, customer meetings, events and speaking engagements through preparation and coordination
Coordinate travel, accommodation and logistics, including international travel alongside the Founder when required
Track actions, deadlines and follow-ups to ensure key priorities are delivered
Work closely with teams across product, engineering and marketing to coordinate information and create polished executive materials
Support company-wide meetings, leadership activities and strategic events as the business continues to grow

Previous experience as an Executive Assistant supporting a Founder, CEO or senior executive in a fast-paced environment
Strong written communication skills, with the confidence to draft messages and communicate on behalf of a senior leader
Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities
Proactive and naturally solutions-focused, someone who anticipates what needs to happen rather than waiting for instructions
Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate confidently with senior stakeholders
Experience working in a start-up , scale-up or high-growth environment would be highly beneficial, but industry background is open

Calm, organised and adaptable in a changing environment
Comfortable working closely with a founder and gaining exposure across different areas of the business
Confident acting as a trusted representative of the Founder
Someone who enjoys variety, ownership and working at pace
A self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment

This is a remote-based role, offering flexibility around location. The successful candidate will need to be comfortable travelling internationally with the Founder when required, supporting meetings, events and speaking engagements.
The Founder has global travel planned over the coming months, so this role would suit someone who enjoys a fast-moving startup environment and the opportunity to be closely involved in the growth of the business.
Why this opportunity?
You’ll work directly with the Founder of a fast-growing AI company at a pivotal point in its journey, gaining exposure across investors, customers, partnerships, events and company building.
This is an opportunity to have a genuine impact, helping shape how a scaling technology business operates while becoming a key person the Founder relies on every day.
If this sounds like you please apply direct or send your CV to zoe.hinkinson@propellondon.com

About Our Client Our client is a specialist GTM, Marketing, Product and Operations recruitment firm for high-growth SaaS and tech companies globally.

Trusted by startups backed by top-tier venture capital firms including Sequoia, a16z, Benchmark and Y Combinator, the team operates on a quality first, consultative model with a near 1:1 submit-to-hire ratio and 100+ successful placements. Their positioning is clear: top 1% talent, not volume.

About the Role This is a critical operational support role within the recruitment team. Reporting directly to the Operations Lead, you will provide end-to-end VA recruitment support across sourcing, candidate research, market mapping, documentation, and CRM administration. This is not a pure recruiter or sourcing-only role.

We are looking for someone with a VA mindset — strong recruitment operations experience, solid general admin capability, and the communication and initiative to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Key Responsibilities
· Source and research candidates across SaaS, Marketing, and IT sectors for US market roles
· Build and maintain talent pipelines through market mapping
· Maintain and update Recruit CRM with accurate candidate, role, and pipeline information
· Prepare and format candidate shortlists and summaries for the recruitment team
· Attend client intake calls as a note-taker — supporting the team, not leading calls
· Handle documentation, process notes, and general recruitment administration
· Liaise professionally with internal team members across US and international time zones
· Support ad hoc tasks as directed by the Operations Lead What You'll Bring Experience & Background
· Minimum 3–4 years of total experience, with at least 2 years in end-to-end recruiting or in a recruitment support capacity — in a VA context
· Industry background in SaaS, Marketing, or IT — healthcare and other unrelated experience is not a fit for this role
· Recent US market experience — you understand the nuances of recruiting for US-based clients A genuine mix of VA, general admin, and recruiting skills — not purely a sourcer or recruiter Communication & Personality
· Strong English — clear and confident in written and verbal communication
· Outspoken and direct — you proactively flag capacity issues and push back professionally when needed
· Flexible and adaptable — comfortable with shifting priorities and ad hoc tasks
· Polished, professional LinkedIn profile (reviewed as part of the selection process)

· Experience with Recruit CRM Bookkeeping or accounts reconciliation experience
· Familiarity with AI and automation tools — Claude Cowork or similar integration platforms
What Success Looks Like
· Consistent, high-quality sourcing output with minimal rework
· Proactive communication — status updates without prompting, blockers flagged early
· CRM and documentation kept current and accurate at all times
· Tasks completed within agreed timelines; clear escalation when timelines are at risk
· Smooth integration with the Operations Lead's workflow and the broader team Originally posted on Himalayas

Cube Care is a US-based custom manufacturing company and we are looking for dedicated and loyal individuals that can contribute to our goals. We are looking for a highly organized and versatile Executive Virtual Assistant / Admin Assistant to support our operations and technical teams.

This role is essential in ensuring smooth day-to-day workflows across various departments by handling a mix of administrative, system-related, and coordination duties.

If you're a proactive problem-solver who enjoys managing both structured and dynamic tasks, this role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute meaningfully while working remotely. Key Responsibilities:
Manage and maintain the CEO and/or Business Director's daily calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and reminders across multiple time zones.
Coordinate internal and external communications on behalf of the CEO and/or Business Director with professionalism and confidentiality.
Follow up and monitor with team members, vendors, clients, and partners on behalf of CEO and/or Business Director
Screen emails, prioritize urgent matters and draft responses when appropriate
Organize virtual meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes of meeting, and ensure follow-up on action items.
Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets , and business docuemnts for executive review.
Maintain accurate and organized digital filing systems and confidential company records.
Conduct online research and compile information for business decisions, partnerships, and strategic initiatives.
Help streamline administrative systems and recommend process improvements for opeerational efficiency.
Track executive priorities and proactively anticipate scheduling conflicts or business needs.
Manage personal executive tasks and ad hoc assignments with discretion and reliability.
Serve as a dependable point of contact between the CEO and/or Business Director and internal/external stakeholders.
Assist with project coordination and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met across departments.
Provide ongoing support for operations, field staff, and internal departments by managing documentation, schedules, and workflows
Coordinate with team members and vendors to ensure smooth logistics, system processes, and equipment support
Monitor business platforms and internal tools for system statuses, updates, and user support
Facilitate issue tracking and resolution by collaborating with field personnel and reporting tools
Assist in weekly and monthly reporting, data entry, and performance logs
Support leadership with executive-level assistance, scheduling, follow-ups, and general support
Ensure all communications and tasks are handled with high level of professionalism, urgency, and confidentiality.
Maintain responsiveness during agreed working hours and provide consistent exectuive support in a remote environment.

Minimum 2 years experience as an Executive Assistant, or in a similar administrative support role
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
Proficient in using digital platforms and productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, task trackers)
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
Capable of managing multiple responsibilities with little supervision
Comfortable troubleshooting and following structured workflows
Reliable and accountable with a solutions-oriented mindset
Familiarity with tools like Odoo, project management systems, or barcode/labeling platforms (Preferred)
Background in coordinating with vendors or handling procurement tasks
Experience in collections, basic bookkeeping, and invoicing is required

Computer Processor: Minimum 5th generation Intel i5 processor or equivalent
Computer Memory/RAM: Minimum 4.00 GB
Computer Operating System: Windows 10 or Mac OSX - No Linux, Unix, or any operating system other than what is required.
Internet Speed: Running on a 5.0 MBPS plan or higher (Both primary and backup) - If your backup connection cannot serve as your primary connection, that does not qualify as a backup connection
REQUIRED Headset: Noise-cancelling headset connected via USB port
REQUIRED WebCam: At least 3 megapixels capable of 720p recording

Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet.

The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.
We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

The Senior Executive Assistant provides strategic administrative partnership to the General Manager, SVP, EMEA, while also supporting additional members of the EMEA leadership team, including coordination of travel, meetings, and regional initiatives for other senior leaders as needed.
This role extends beyond traditional executive support by serving as a trusted operational partner who helps drive communication, coordination, and execution across the EMEA organization. Success in this role requires exceptional organizational skills, business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate needs while managing competing priorities across a dynamic, global business.
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and is equally comfortable managing executive priorities, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and fostering collaboration across multiple teams and regions. They are a proactive problem solver who communicates effectively, thinks strategically, and continuously looks for opportunities to improve how the business operates.
At Fastly, we hire administrative professionals who are reliable, highly organized, and proactive problem solvers. They are self-starters driven by curiosity, always looking for ways to optimize processes and move the business forward.

Our team excels at managing multiple priorities simultaneously, demonstrating strong communication skills across all levels of the organization. They anticipate needs, solve challenges before they arise, and contribute meaningfully to the success of both their executives and the broader business.

s.h: What You’ll Do as the Senior Executive Assistant to the CMO
s.t:
Executive Partnership
Manage complex executive calendars, ensuring priorities are aligned with business objectives and making thoughtful recommendations on time allocation.
Coordinate domestic and international travel for supported executives while balancing evolving business priorities.
Manage expense reporting accurately and efficiently.
Prepare agendas, presentations, briefing materials, and documentation for executive and leadership meetings.
Capture meeting notes, distribute action items, and track follow-up to completion.
Business Operations & Regional Coordination
Serve as a trusted operational partner to the General Manager, SVP, EMEA and members of the EMEA leadership team.
Coordinate communication across EMEA leadership, global cross-functional partners, and external stakeholders.
Support planning and execution of regional leadership meetings, customer engagements, executive visits, offsites, and key business events.
Support cross-regional initiatives and operational programs that span multiple organizations.
Assist with marketing and GTM events across EMEA as needed.
Facilitate effective communication to ensure important information is shared consistently across the EMEA region.
Strategic Partnership
Develop a strong understanding of the EMEA business, organizational priorities, leadership team, and operating rhythms.
Anticipate executive and business needs by thinking ahead and identifying potential risks or conflicts before they arise.
Recommend process improvements that increase operational efficiency and improve collaboration.
Coordinate follow-up across multiple stakeholders to ensure key initiatives continue moving forward.
Office & Team Support
Support London office initiatives and executive visits.
Partner closely with Executive Assistants and Business Partners across the company to ensure seamless coordination across regions.
Contribute as an active member of Fastly's administrative community, sharing best practices and supporting team success.
We're seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Senior Executive Assistant who enjoys becoming deeply integrated into the business they support.

Demonstrate exceptional communication skills and build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.
Thrive managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
Anticipate future needs, think strategically, and proactively solve problems before they become obstacles.
Possess strong business curiosity and an analytical mindset to understand the business, its priorities, and the people they support.
Have outstanding organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Be adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity while maintaining focus on key priorities.
Demonstrate confidence using technology and collaboration tools to improve workflows and increase efficiency.
Handle confidential information with the highest level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
Partner effectively across cross-functional teams while maintaining strong executive presence and sound judgment.

5+ years of experience supporting senior executives in a fast-paced technology company.
Experience supporting Sales, Go-to-Market, Customer, or other revenue organizations.
Experience working across multiple countries and time zones within a global organization.
Demonstrated success coordinating executive meetings, leadership offsites, customer engagements, and regional events.
Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Coupa, and other modern workplace technologies.
Business Administration qualification or equivalent professional experience preferred.
Why Fastly?
We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives . Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.
We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.
We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.
We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.
All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers . We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @ fastly.com or @ recruiting.fastly.com email address.

About Agicap
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!
Tasks

1. Office operations
Ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office (supplies, equipment, maintenance, badge access).
Be the main point of contact with the space provider (coworking / landlord).
Ensure compliance with fire safety and local regulatory obligations.
Monitor office occupancy trends and anticipate future space needs.
Manage the relationship with building- and equipment-related vendors (cleaning, security, maintenance).
Ensure the office quality meets Agicap's standards.
2. Office life and employee experience
Organize team events and initiatives that foster cohesion and employee engagement.
Manage employee services (snacks, drinks, amenities, small orders).
Act as the local point of contact for the needs and feedback of the German team.
3. Onboarding / Offboarding
Prepare the arrival of new joiners (workstation, equipment, welcome pack).
Support departing employees (administrative and logistical offboarding).
4. Administrative support and local compliance
Provide first-level support on administrative matters (supplier contracts, invoices, expense reports).
Contribute to monitoring local legal obligations, working with the Legal, Finance, and HR teams at headquarters.
5. Reporting and coordination
Provide regular reporting to the manager on activity and ongoing topics.
Take part in Office Management team meetings and contribute to sharing best practices across offices.
Monitor the Berlin office's operating budget.

Native or fluent German, with professional-level English required to communicate with the manager and colleagues.
Proven experience in a similar role (office management, administrative coordination, facilities) within an international
environment.
Strong sense of organization, autonomy, and rigor, with the ability to manage a wide range of information.
Good interpersonal skills, service-oriented mindset, and ability to work in a multicultural environment.
Flexibility and pragmatism, comfortable switching between different tasks.
Contract type: Permanent contract - 50% - 4h/day – Monday to Friday

Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components.
Prime Office Location: Work from a large, modern office at Moritzplatz (Berlin) featuring a large terrace, snacks, and drinks.
Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy.
Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with regular events in Berlin and occasional trips to our headquarters in France.
Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app.
Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service.
Team Culture: Be part of a dynamic environment with global offsites (like our recent annual seminar in the South of France) and local team events.
Agicap is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

We’re looking for a highly capable, analytical, and proactive Executive Assistant & Business Operations Specialist who can operate as a genuine extension of the Principal.

Instead, we need a commercially minded Executive Assistant who is comfortable working across different areas of a business, can quickly understand new concepts, and has the judgment to determine what needs to happen without always waiting for detailed instructions.
You’ll move between executive support, stakeholder communication, light financial administration, research, and operational projects. Conduct business, market, client, industry, and other research as required.
Analyze information and turn it into clear summaries, reports, and actionable recommendations.
Support operational and strategic projects across different areas of the business.
Coordinate projects, internal processes, deadlines, and follow-ups across stakeholders.
Take ownership of assigned projects from start to finish.
Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical ways to improve processes and reduce administrative workload.

Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms extensively for research, analysis, drafting, summarization, and organization.
Use AI to accelerate work while applying strong judgment to verify, refine, and improve outputs.
Identify opportunities to incorporate AI and simple automation into everyday workflows.
Help the Principal and wider business operate more efficiently by finding smarter ways to organize and execute recurring work.

Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Business Assistant, Operations Assistant, Business Operations Specialist, or in a similarly broad support role.
Experience supporting a founder, executive, business owner, or senior leader.
Excellent written and spoken English, including strong professional and business writing skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Experience using QuickBooks or similar accounting software and a good understanding of basic financial administration.
Familiarity with areas such as AR/AP, reconciliations, payroll administration, and financial documentation.
Strong proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT and/or Claude and the ability to use them for meaningful business work.
Strong research skills with the ability to synthesize information and communicate key findings clearly.
Excellent organization and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and projects simultaneously.
Strong judgment and the confidence to determine priorities and next steps independently.
High level of discretion when handling confidential information.
Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.
Nice-to-Haves
Previous experience within professional services, consulting, financial services, banking, accounting, corporate services, real estate, or another commercially focused environment.
Experience supporting bookkeeping, VAT documentation, or similar finance administration.
Experience using Google Workspace, Microsoft Outlook, Google Drive, and similar business productivity tools.
Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement or basic workflow automation.

This role is ideal for someone who is more than an administrator .
You're intellectually curious, commercially aware, and able to quickly understand how a business works. If you're given an objective rather than a detailed set of instructions, you're comfortable figuring out the steps required and moving things forward.
You can confidently switch between drafting an important client email, researching a business opportunity, updating QuickBooks, preparing meeting notes, following up on an outstanding payment, and using AI to turn a large amount of information into a concise executive summary.

For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

This is not a traditional EA role. The Senior Executive Assistant II to our VP of Customer Success operates as a trusted extension of executive leadership — equal parts strategic operator, project manager, and thought partner. You will sit at the center of a large, fast-moving organization and use your judgment, initiative, and influence to keep the VP and his team running at peak velocity.
You will own the executive experience end-to-end: anticipating needs before they're voiced, navigating complex stakeholder dynamics, and turning ambiguous requests into crisp execution. If you thrive in environments where no two days are the same and you find energy in being the connective tissue of a high-performing org, this role is for you.
This is a remote role based in the US, however candidates must be able to support west coast hours and be open to travel 1 trip per month. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
You Should Apply If
You want to work on problems that matter. Samsara connects the physical and digital worlds — keeping workers safe, supply chains moving, and emissions in check. Your leverage as an EBP is real.
You're an operator, not just a coordinator. You see the system behind every calendar invite, build processes that outlast you, and default to ownership over escalation.
You thrive with ambiguity and pace. You can hold ten priorities, drop the right three, and communicate clearly about all of it — without being asked twice.
You care about the craft. Being a truly elite EBP is a skill. You're always learning, always refining, and you take pride in raising the bar for everyone around you.
What You'll Own
Executive presence & flow — Manage the VP's calendar, communications, and daily operating rhythm with a level of foresight that makes him feel three steps ahead.
Complex travel & logistics — Plan and book multi-leg domestic and international travel (~1 trip/month), anticipating buffers, prep materials, and regional stakeholder touchpoints before they're requested.
Stakeholder management — Act as a trusted liaison to senior leaders, investors, and cross-functional partners internally and externally; you represent leaders in every interaction.
Operational continuity — Own expenses, team meeting agendas, action item tracking, and the behind-the-scenes coordination that keeps a large org accountable and moving.
Events & onsites — Lead planning and execution of team onsites, offsites, and executive events with high attention to detail and a sharp instinct for what makes the experience feel intentional.
Special projects — Take on high-impact, time-sensitive projects that cut across the org — from preparing exec briefings to driving cross-functional initiatives on the VP's behalf.
Culture carrier — Champion Samsara's operating principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) and model them every day.

Must-haves
6+ years of experience supporting VP-level or above executives and GTM/Sales experience in a fast-paced environment
Proven ability to operate with discretion, sound judgment, and high EQ in sensitive or ambiguous situations
Exceptional communication skills — you write, speak, and represent with polish and precision
A track record of building systems and processes that scale, not just executing tasks
Ability to maintain San Francisco business hours (Pacific Time), regardless of location
Flexibility to travel approximately once per month for onsites and executive support

Familiarity with enterprise SaaS or high-growth technology environments
Comfort with productivity and AI tools (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, AI assistants)

To meet the minimum qualification requirements for this position, you must show that you possess the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQ) and Technical Qualifications (TQ) related to this position within your resume - NOT TO EXCEED 2 PAGES.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS (TQs): Your resume must clearly demonstrate that you possess the following technical qualifications.

EXECUTIVE CORE QUALIFICATIONS (ECQs): In addition to the Technical Qualification Requirements listed above, all new entrants into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment will be assessed for executive competency against the following five mandatory ECQs.

ECQ 2: Driving Efficiency - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to strategically and efficiently manage resources, budget effectively, cut wasteful spending, and pursue efficiency through process and technological upgrades.

ECQ 3: Merit and Competence - This core qualification involves the demonstrated knowledge, ability and technical competence to effectively and reliably produce work that is of exceptional quality.

ECQ 5: Achieving Results - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to achieve both individual and organizational results, and to align results to stated goals from superiors.

Assistenz Geschäftsleitung \& Marketing/Kommunikation 60\-80%
==============================================================
Das Kompetenzzentrum APPISBERG begleitet Menschen mit besonderem Unterstützungsbedarf auf ihrem Weg in Ausbildung, Qualifizierung und Arbeit. Wir verbinden fachliche Expertise mit einer klaren Haltung: Menschen stehen im Zentrum, Entwicklung braucht Struktur, und nachhaltige Integration entsteht durch professionelle Zusammenarbeit.
Wir schaffen eine neue Funktion, die unsere Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft unterstützt und dabei Marketing, Kommunikation, Events und administrative Aufgaben wirkungsvoll verbindet.
**Deine Rolle: Assistenz Geschäftsleitung \& Marketing/Kommunikation 60\-80%**
**Start: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung**
Du hältst die Fäden zusammen, bereitest Abläufe, Unterlagen und Informationen sorgfältig vor und sorgst dafür, dass organisatorische und administrative Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. Damit leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu, dass im Alltag alles gut vorbereitet ist und reibungslos läuft.
**Deine Aufgaben \- hier gestaltest du mit**
* Administrative und organisatorische Unterstützung der Geschäftsleitung
* Organisation, Vor\- und Nachbearbeitung von Sitzungen
* Protokollführung inkl. Nachverfolgung von Beschlüssen und vereinbarten Massnahmen
* Aufbereitung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Übersichten und Präsentationen
* Administrative und organisatorische Marketing\- \& Kommunikationsaktivitäten (Termine, Unterlagen, Events)
* Pflege, Aktualisierung und Aufbereitung zentraler Marketing\- und Kommunikationsunterlagen nach Vorgaben
**Das bringst du mit**
* Erfahrung in einer Assistenz\-, Service\- oder Koordinationsfunktion in einem professionellen Umfeld
* Verständnis für Marketing\- und Kommunikationsprozesse sowie Routine im Arbeiten mit Präsentationen und Standardunterlagen
* Weiterbildung im Bereich Management, Assistenz oder Marketing (z. B. Direktions\-, Marketingassistenz o. ä.) von Vorteil
* Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools (u. a. Office\-Anwendungen) sowie stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift
* Diskretion, Vertrauenswürdigkeit und professioneller Umgang mit sensiblen Informationen
* Organisationsflair und Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu priorisieren sowie mehrere Themen parallel zu koordinieren
* Serviceorientierte, verbindliche Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Abläufe und Zuständigkeiten
* Freude an einer unterstützenden Rolle in einem sinnstiftenden, sozialen Umfeld
**Das bieten wir dir**
* Klare Aufgaben, saubere Zuständigkeiten und eine strukturierte Zusammenarbeit
* Ein professionelles Arbeitsumfeld, das Verlässlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Qualität schätzt
* Ein wertschätzendes Team, das sich auf Augenhöhe begegnet und eine offene, respektvolle Arbeitskultur
* Einen Arbeitsplatz mit Lebensqualität, guter Erreichbarkeit, gratis Parkplatz und Shuttle\-Service ab Bahnhof
* Zeitgemässe Arbeitsbedingungen, die eine verlässliche Teilzeittätigkeit ermöglichen
